title: Special provision for deduction of tax at source for non-filers of income-tax return

effectivePeriod.annualReset: Every assessment year based on preceding FY return filing deadline

plainTextSummary: Where tax is required to be deducted at source on any sum paid or payable to a specified person (a person who has not filed their ITR for the preceding financial year and has aggregate TDS/TCS of ₹50,000 or more in said year), the tax shall be deducted at the higher of: (i) twice the rate specified in the relevant Act, (ii) twice the rate in force, or (iii) 5%. If Section 206AA (no-PAN) also applies, tax is deducted at the higher of 206AA or 206AB rates. Does NOT apply to non-residents without a PE in India, or to Sections 192, 192A, 194B, 194BA, 194BB, 194-IA, 194-IB, 194M, 194N.

keyStatutoryThresholds.penaltyMultiplier: Twice the applicable rate or 5%, whichever is higher
keyStatutoryThresholds.section206aaHarmonization: Higher of Section 206AA rate (20%) or Section 206AB rate

officialCitations.subject: Compliance Check functionality for Section 206AB & Section 206CCA

requiredDocumentChecklist: Compliance Check for Section 206AB & 206CCA verification report from Income Tax e-filing portal
Acknowledgment of Income Tax Return (ITR-V) for preceding assessment year
Vendor PAN Card / TRACES status verification
